race.title: Fatty Renshaw Memorial Novices' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: In a race where few arrive with compelling claims MATCHING ENERGY is taken to build on his encouraging Perth reappearance and prove too strong for recent Fontwell scorer Diamond White . John Dawson handicap newcomer Whin Cover is next on the list. MATCHING ENERGY DIAMOND WHITE (IRE) WHIN COVER
race.bettingForecast: Diamond White (13/8), Bo Cruz (11/4), Diamond Jim (8/1), Whin Cover (8/1), Espoir Des Forges (14/1), Matching Energy (14/1), Disguisedlimit (16/1), Karma De Cotte (16/1), Cool Master (16/1), Reliance Kid (33/1)
